announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l4 — GPT-6.1 Terra pricing
announcements.summary: Adds correct local usage pricing for GPT-6.1 Terra and keeps the Dashboard copy cleanup.
announcements.content:
This stable local build adds GPT-6.1 Terra to the local Codex usage price estimator using the standard API rates.
1. Pricing: recognize gpt-6.1-terra input, cached-input, and output tokens.
2. Dashboard: retain the recent copy cleanup across the Dashboard, settings, account details, About panel, and advanced appearance.
3. Compatibility: preserve the existing extension identity, private-state boundaries, account formats, and local integrations.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l4 — GPT-6.1 Terra 计费
zh.summary: 新增 GPT-6.1 Terra 的本机用量计费识别，并保留 Dashboard 文案精简。
zh.content:
本稳定本地版本为本机 Codex 用量价格估算加入 GPT-6.1 Terra 的标准 API 费率。
1. 计费：识别 gpt-6.1-terra 的输入、缓存输入和输出 Token。
2. Dashboard：保留 Dashboard、设置、账号详情、About 和高级外观的近期文案精简。
3. 兼容性：保留既有扩展 ID、私有状态边界、账号格式和本地集成功能。
